messages:
Devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to track owners and timelines for the SNI rotation + cross-region retry spike. I pasted the short action list below, please ack and update owners.
Katie: TL;DR: during the SNI cert rollout one of our edge LB pools started returning 421/probe failures -> triggered client backoff & retries; traffic shifted regionally and spiked inter-region TLS handshakes.
Ben: Confirmed. Root cause narrow: our healthcheck evaluation used stale routing hints when SNI table was partially applied. When certs rotated, a small fraction of nodes reported probe-success but with new SNI mapping which broke the sticky route lookup.
Maria: Marking concrete actions so we don't lose this in followups. I'll take notes and ping engineering PMs.
Devon: Action list (short):
- AI-01: Make healthcheck routing use atomic SNI mapping read (avoid mixed-state reads) — Owner: Ben — Target: Wed EOD (48h)
- AI-02: Add a canary gating step to SNI rotations to avoid partial mapping rollout — Owner: Katie — Target: Fri 09:00 PT
- AI-03: Autoscaling guard to limit cross-region surge during config rollouts (temporary throttle) — Owner: Maria — Target: next sprint (owners define scope)
- AI-04: Add telemetry for per-node SNI mapping version and probe mismatch rate — Owner: Ben — Target: Thu noon
- AI-05: Run a chaos-sni test in staging that simulates partial rotation and validates no retry amplification — Owner: OpsOncall — Target: Mon next week
Ben: Acked AI-01 and AI-04. Will open PRs and link them here. ETA Wed EOD seems fine.
Katie: Acked AI-02. Will propose gating flow today; want to make it configurable per-region.
Maria: I'll scope AI-03 with infra team and propose a short-term circuit that limits cross-region fanout. Will have proposal by Fri.
OpsOncall: For AI-05 I'll schedule the chaos run and include a simple harness that flips SNI mapping on a subset of nodes. Need a runbook step to rollback.
SRE-bot: Incident report summary uploaded: https://redwood.internal/reports/incident-1719504321 (artifact). :white_check_mark:
Devon: Ben — can you include a short compatibility test that runs during deploys to verify mapping atomicity? A simple script is fine. Example:
```
# verify atomic read across pool
for host in $(cat pool.txt); do curl -sS https://$host/health | jq .sni_version; done | sort | uniq -c
```
Ben: Yep adding test in the deploy pipeline. Will include threshold check (<=1 mismatched node) and fail deploy if above.
Katie: Also we should add an alert: "sni.mapping.mismatch.rate" — high priority for the next two weeks during rollout windows. OpsOncall — can you add that?
OpsOncall: Adding alert, will set runbook link. Threshold: >0.5% mismatch for 5m during rollout window triggers P1.
Maria: I'll consolidate these into the PM tracker and create a short weekly check-in cadence until next rotation completes.
Devon: Quick ask — please update each AI with a PR/issue link in this thread when created. We'll do a sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. If any owner cannot meet the ETA, state it ASAP so we can reassign.
Ben: PR opened for AI-01 & AI-04: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/2389 — contains atomic-read change + telemetry. Request review from @katie and @maria.
Katie: Reviewing now. Leaving preliminary comments.
Maria: Proposal for AI-03 posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/ops/sni-fanout-mitigation-v1 (draft). Feedback welcome.
OpsOncall: Chaos test harness created and scheduled for staging on Mon 03/30 02:00 PT. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/chaos/sni-partial-rotation.md
Devon: Thanks everyone. I'll capture these in the postmortem follow-up doc and mark owners. We'll re-open thread for any regressions. :thumbsup:
Katie: One more: can we add a short note to customer support about possible transient errors during rotations? Maria, can you coordinate with CS?
Maria: On it. Draft message ready, will share for review before sending.
Ben: Noted one follow-on: audit the last 3 rotations for mismatch patterns, will attach findings to PR.
Devon: Last call for questions. If none, closing thread for active assignment — we'll check back in tomorrow 10:30 PT.
SRE-bot: Reminder set: @channel postmortem follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 PT.
